description: Ocean Overhaul — a ocean-content mod for Minecraft 1.21.1 (Fabric)

mods.name: Ocean Overhaul
mods.description: Adds 41 ocean-themed blocks (decorative prismarine, pearl, and sea glass sets, a full driftwood wood set, and the deep-ocean Abyssal Trench's glowing plankton, abyssal vents, and giant clams), the Tidal tool + armor sets, a deep-sea diving kit (Deep-Sea Helmet, Oxygen Tank, Flippers), the loyalty-throw Harpoon, a stockable Aquarium, Reef Fish + Jellyfish + Seahorse buckets, ocean foods, Megalodon Tooth + Abyssal Fang + Heart of the Kraken drops, seven naturally-spawning sea creatures (the Megalodon and Kraken bosses, the hostile Abyssal Lurker, Reef Fish, Jellyfish, the bucketable color-variant Seahorse, and the breedable beach-dwelling Shore Crab), and ambient bioluminescent plankton blooms with glowing disturbance trails, a crafted-only shipwreck decor set (anchor, ship’s wheel, climbable rope, tattered sail), spreading Living Abyssal Coral, pearl-growing giant clams, plus a dedicated Ocean Overhaul creative tab.

mods.name: Ocean Overhaul
mods.description: Adds 36 ocean-themed blocks (decorative prismarine, pearl, and sea glass sets, a full driftwood wood set, and the deep-ocean Abyssal Trench's glowing plankton, abyssal vents, and giant clams), the Tidal tool + armor sets, a deep-sea diving kit (Deep-Sea Helmet, Oxygen Tank, Flippers), the loyalty-throw Harpoon, a stockable Aquarium, Reef Fish + Jellyfish buckets, ocean foods, Megalodon Tooth + Abyssal Fang + Heart of the Kraken drops, and five naturally-spawning sea creatures (the Megalodon and Kraken bosses, the hostile Abyssal Lurker, Reef Fish, and Jellyfish), plus a dedicated Ocean Overhaul creative tab.

mods.name: Ocean Overhaul
mods.description: Adds 32 ocean-themed blocks (decorative: Abyssal Coral Block, Sea Glass, Polished Prismarine Bricks, Pearl Block, Chiseled Prismarine Tiles — most with stairs/slab/wall; driftwood functional set: Driftwood Plank + stairs/slab/wall, Fence, Fence Gate, Trapdoor, Door, Button, Pressure Plate; plus Pearl Lantern, Salt Block, Barnacle Block, Abyssal Pearl Block, Crushed Coral Block, Prismarine Crystal Block), items (Tide Pearl, Coral Shard, Sea Salt, Abyssal Pearl, Crushed Coral, Sea Urchin, Salted Cod, plus the Tidal diving tool + armor set), four entities (the Megalodon boss, the hostile deep-sea Abyssal Lurker anglerfish, and Reef Fish + Jellyfish passive mobs that naturally spawn in oceans), and a dedicated Ocean Overhaul creative tab.
